# Was the Ticketmaster outage on Nov 20 a cyberattack?

**Not established.** Ticketmaster has not given a cause, and no source we read says the outage was an attack or rules one out. Nobody has claimed responsibility. The only suggestion of one is an anonymous comment with no evidence.

Incident: Ticketmaster outage, Nov 20, 2026. Also reported as the Ticketmaster outage and Ticketmaster down. First published Nov 21, 2026; last updated Nov 21, 2026, 2:16 AM ET.

> **Not verified: initial investigation only.** Nothing on this page is absolutely confirmed. It is an early look based only on publicly available sources, and it should not be treated as verified fact. Even items labeled "Confirmed" only mean a public source reports them. ## The latest

Nov 21, 2026, 2:16 AM ET: **Ticketmaster has not said what caused its Nov 20 outage. Nobody has claimed or reported a hack.** First draft. 9 sources (1 Tier 1, 7 Tier 2, 1 Tier 3), 15 claims (2 Confirmed, 9 Reported, 1 Rumor, 3 Not established), 7 questions. The Friday outage at the Caesars Superdome is Confirmed by the organizer's and the venue manager's own statements. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. An anonymous 'probing' comment is carried as a Rumor with no evidence. The Nov 19 South Dakota disruption rests on one outlet. The brief's 'mostly fixed by about 10 PM ET' became about 10:30 PM ET because the venue's times are Central. Privacy check done: no names of private people, no handles, no contact details.

## At a glance

- Status: monitoring
- Size: Large. Ticketmaster sells tickets for events across the country, and fans at a stadium show could not get in. Reports came from several states and abroad. Ticketmaster has not said how many people were affected.
- Who is affected: People with Ticketmaster tickets who tried to load them on Friday evening, Nov 20, most visibly at the Caesars Superdome. It appears mostly fixed. Saving tickets to a phone wallet ahead of time avoided the problem at the Superdome.

| Value | What | Detail |
|---|---|---|
| ~500 | Downdetector reports | Mostly about the app, from 8:33 PM ET |
| 2 | Nights with disruption reported | Nov 19 and Nov 20 |

### Known so far

- Ticketmaster's service had an outage on Friday night, Nov 20, that kept fans at the Superdome from loading mobile tickets, according to the event organizer and the venue manager.
- The White House said on Nov 18 that it sees no indication of a cyberattack behind recent tech outages. That was before this outage and does not name Ticketmaster.

### Not known yet

- What caused the outage. Ticketmaster has not said.
- Whether it was a cyberattack. No one has claimed one, reported one, or ruled one out.
- Whether it is linked to the Nov 19 disruption or to other outages this month.
- How many people were affected.

Hindustan Times and others call the outage 'nationwide', and ASM Global's spokesperson called it nationwide. | [WDSU: New Orleans Ticketmaster customers report outage during concert at Superdome](https://www.wdsu.com/article/ticketmaster-outage-new-orleans/74496162), [WWL-TV: Ticketmaster outage leaves crowds waiting outside Caesars Superdome for Usher, Chris Brown concert](https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/local/thousands-stuck-outside-superdome-for-usher-and-chris-brown-concert-officials-say-ticketmaster-is-down-new-orleans/289-319899b2-1f45-4290-abb6-4c97fa947a31) |

## Related, but separate

| Claim | Label | What we know | Why it supports, and more detail | Sources |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| The Ticketmaster outage is linked to Thursday's disruption or to this month's other outages | Not established | No source links the Nov 20 outage to the Nov 19 disruption, to Ticketmaster's October transfer problems, or to the FAA, Microsoft 365, bank or other outages of recent weeks. | No source ties the events together or rules it out for Ticketmaster. Hindustan Times mentions the string of outages but offers no link. TicketNews notes the November 12-13 Microsoft outage affected ticket access through email but treats it as separate. The same company is involved on both nights, which is why we ask. | [Hindustan Times: Ticketmaster down for hundreds, complain users; company says 'not seeing any reported issues'](https://www.hindustantimes.com/world-news/us-news/ticketmaster-down-update-hundreds-of-users-complain-company-says-not-seeing-any-reported-issues-login-downdetector-101795227503139.html), [TicketNews: Ticketmaster Outage Disrupts Event Entry as Fans Report Widespread Problems](https://www.ticketnews.com/2026/11/ticketmaster-outage-volleyball-tournament/), [The White House: “No Indication of a Cyberattack” on recent tech outages](https://www.whitehouse.gov/releases/2026/11/no-indication-of-a-cyberattack-dni-clayton-and-secretary-rubio-on-recent-tech-outages/), [WWL-TV: Ticketmaster outage leaves crowds waiting outside Caesars Superdome for Usher, Chris Brown concert](https://www.wwltv.com/article/news/local/thousands-stuck-outside-superdome-for-usher-and-chris-brown-concert-officials-say-ticketmaster-is-down-new-orleans/289-319899b2-1f45-4290-abb6-4c97fa947a31) |

The release came two days before the Ticketmaster outage and does not mention Ticketmaster, so it is context, not a finding about Ticketmaster. It confirms what officials said, not an independent finding. | [The White House: “No Indication of a Cyberattack” on recent tech outages](https://www.whitehouse.gov/releases/2026/11/no-indication-of-a-cyberattack-dni-clayton-and-secretary-rubio-on-recent-tech-outages/) |

## What we checked and did not find

We looked for these and did not find them as of the time of this page's first draft.

- A Ticketmaster or Live Nation statement giving the cause of the Nov 20 outage or the Nov 19 disruption.
- A Ticketmaster status page or incident notice. We did not find a public one.
- Any vendor, cloud provider or software update named as involved.
- Any claim of responsibility or credible report of a hack.
- Any statement from an official body tying the outage to the week's other outages. The White House's Nov 18 statement predates it and does not name Ticketmaster.
- A count of affected customers.
- The Ticketmaster posts on X themselves. We relied on how news outlets quote them.
- The Dakota News Now report on the volleyball tournament, which TicketNews cites.

The Friday outage at the Caesars Superdome is Confirmed by the organizer's and the venue manager's own statements. Whether it was a cyberattack is Not established: no cause, no claim, no statement either way. An anonymous 'probing' comment is carried as a Rumor with no evidence.
